problems.quote: Questions may ask for the year with the highest growth rate; this is found by computing the slope for each adjacent pair and selecting the maximum.
problems.problem: Growth rate is percentage change ((new−old)/old)×100, not the slope (absolute change per period). The slope (v₂−v₁)/(t₂−t₁) is average periodic change, not growth rate.
problems.correction: Questions may ask for the year with the highest growth rate; this is found by computing the percentage change for each adjacent pair and selecting the maximum.
problems.verifierReason: Growth rate is standardly defined as percentage change, not absolute slope. Correction accurately fixes this definition error.

problems.quote: Because φ(10)=4, any base coprime to 10 repeats every 4.
problems.problem: The period of the last digit for bases coprime to 10 divides 4, but is not always 4 (e.g., base 9 has period 2, base 1 has period 1).
problems.correction: Because φ(10)=4, any base coprime to 10 has a period dividing 4.
problems.verifierReason: Euler's theorem gives a^4≡1 mod 10, so order divides 4; base 9 has order 2, base 1 has order 1.
